items.name: lantern-theme
items.title: Lantern theme
items.description: Lantern colors, fonts, block shadows, the grid pattern and the pulse and blink animations.

items.name: ambient
items.title: Ambient
items.description: The soft olive or amber corner glow from the Lantern hero, as a decorative background layer.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code panel with a filename bar, language badge, copy button, optional line numbers and highlighted lines. No syntax highlighter required.

items.name: command-tabs
items.title: Command Tabs
items.description: A package manager switcher that shows the same command for npm, pnpm, yarn and bun, with a copy button. The chosen manager is remembered and shared by every instance on the page.

items.name: console
items.title: Console
items.description: TurtleDeck's log console: timestamped lines in four levels that stay scrolled to the newest entry, over a command row with an orange prompt.

items.name: control-pad
items.title: Control Pad
items.description: The TurtleDeck movement pad: a 3x3 grid of buttons with icons, labels and key hints. Optional keyboard binding presses the matching button.

items.name: directory-card
items.title: Directory Card
items.description: The Lantern directory listing: a grid banner with an icon and hub address, category, title, description, tags and a status footer.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: The mono uppercase label that sits above Lantern headings.

items.name: guestbook
items.title: Guestbook
items.description: A list of signed messages with a composer, like the Lantern guestbook. Entries show initials, a name, relative time and the message.

items.name: inventory-grid
items.title: Inventory Grid
items.description: TurtleDeck's inventory: square slots on a faint grid with beveled item swatches, short names and stack counts. The selected slot gets an orange border and the arrow keys move it.

items.name: key-reveal
items.title: Key Reveal
items.description: TurtleDeck's show-once key box: the key in mono type with a copy button, an optional masked mode with a reveal toggle, and a warning that it will not be shown again.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: The Lantern site header: diamond mark, name and outlined tag, nav links and a bordered call to action. On phones the links move into a sheet behind a menu button.

items.name: orbit
items.title: Orbit
items.description: The dashed elliptical rings behind the Lantern hero terminal, as a decorative background layer with optional slow rotation.

items.name: server-card
items.title: Server Card
items.description: A Minecraft server status card with a copyable address, online state, a player bar, version badge, MOTD and an initials stack of who is on.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: The numbers strip from the Lantern site: large orange figures with a muted caption, split by dividers and stacked on mobile.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A small glowing dot for online, running, error and offline states. Pulses by default.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status Pill
items.description: The TurtleDeck status label: a colored dot and a mono uppercase word for online, offline, running and idle. Running pulses.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: The in-game terminal window from the Lantern hero: title bar, address line, prompt lines, output and a blinking cursor.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Terminal lines that type themselves out, with a pause between lines, an optional loop and a blinking cursor. Use it inside a Terminal or on its own.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Orange primary actions and quiet outlined secondaries, with sizes, icons and link rendering.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins buttons, inputs and text into one control with shared borders, laid out horizontally or vertically.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range of days, built on React DayPicker with orange selection and today marked.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A square toggle for yes or no choices, with checked, indeterminate and disabled states.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable picker built from a popover and a command list, with a single-value Combobox and a multi-select ComboboxMulti that shows picks as badges.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: An icon button that copies a value to the clipboard and flashes a green check. Failures show a red cross instead of throwing.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A button that opens a calendar in a popover, for picking a single date or a range, with optional presets.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Building blocks for accessible forms: labels, descriptions, errors, fieldsets and legends in vertical, horizontal or responsive layouts.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Form building blocks wired to react-hook-form, with zod validation, accessible labels, descriptions and error messages.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field for text, email, passwords and files, with invalid and disabled states.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input or textarea with icons, text prefixes like hub://, and inline buttons attached inside one border.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A row of single-character slots for pairing codes and one-time passwords, with paste support.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible label for form controls.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A styled native select element with the Input look, a chevron, options and option groups.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of options where exactly one can be picked, navigable with the arrow keys.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown for picking one value from a list, with groups, labels, icons and full keyboard support.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number or a range by dragging square thumbs along a track, or with the arrow keys.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on and off control for settings that take effect right away.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A text field that turns what you type into removable tags. Enter or comma adds a tag, Backspace on an empty field removes the last one, and pasting a comma separated list adds several.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content, with invalid and disabled states.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed, for switching a single tool or view on and off.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of toggles joined together, allowing one or many to be pressed.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked questions that open one panel at a time, with a rotating chevron and orange open state.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps media and placeholders at a fixed width to height ratio as the container resizes.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round player portrait with an image and mono initials as the fallback. Group several into an overlapping stack.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small mono labels, including the square outlined tag used for HUB and DEV.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A panel with header, content and footer slots, plus the grid-patterned art banner from the Lantern directory.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A swipeable row of slides with previous and next buttons and dot indicators. Built on Embla.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A flexible row for lists of things: media, title, description and actions, with outline and muted variants.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Mono key caps for keyboard shortcuts. KbdGroup lines several keys up with even spacing.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel rule in the border color, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A plain, responsive table with mono uppercase column heads, hover rows, a footer and a caption. Scrolls sideways on narrow screens.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical changelog or roadmap: a dot or icon on a connecting line, a mono date or version label, a title and a description, marked done, current or planned.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Long-form text styles: headings, paragraphs, lead, lists, quotes, inline code and tables as small components, plus a Prose wrapper that styles raw HTML or rendered markdown.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts v3 wrappers: a responsive ChartContainer driven by a ChartConfig of series labels and colors, plus a Lantern tooltip and legend. Axes and grid lines pick up border and muted colors.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A reusable TanStack Table v9 data table with a global filter, sortable headers, a column visibility menu, row selection and pagination, built on the Lantern table, input, checkbox, dropdown menu and select.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides a section of content with an animated height.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets the reading direction for Radix components below it, so menus, selects and sliders mirror correctly in right to left layouts.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet with a grab handle that can be dragged closed. Built on vaul.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by draggable handles, for editors and dashboards. Built on react-resizable-panels.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll container with a thin custom scrollbar that turns orange on hover.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A composable app sidebar that collapses off canvas or down to icons, and turns into a sheet on phones.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts to confirm an important action. It does not close on outside click, so the reader has to choose.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu opened by right-clicking an area, with labels, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over a dimmed backdrop, for short forms and focused reading. Focus is trapped inside and Escape closes it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with labels, separators, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card that opens when a pointer rests on a link, such as a creator profile behind a username.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small floating panel anchored to a trigger, for quick settings and short forms.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A dialog that slides in from an edge of the screen, for settings panels and mobile navigation.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A dark label in small mono type that appears on hover or keyboard focus. Good for naming icon buttons.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where a page sits in the site, in small mono uppercase with chevron separators.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable command palette with grouped items and shortcuts, inline or in a dialog opened with Cmd K.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: An accessible tree of folders and files with indentation guides, an orange selected border and status letters like M for modified.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus like a desktop app's menu bar, with shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A header menu whose triggers open panels of links in a shared viewport, with an orange indicator under the open trigger.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with previous and next controls. The current page gets an orange outline.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Numbered steps with zero-padded mono numbers in bordered squares. Complete steps turn green with a check and the current step is orange.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Mono uppercase tabs with an orange underline on the active tab, plus a boxed variant for switching between panels.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline callout with an icon, title and description. Default, success, warning and destructive variants each carry a colored left edge.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement Bar
items.description: A slim full-width bar for the top of a site with an optional badge, a message, a link and a dismiss button that can remember the dismissal.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state with an icon in a grid-patterned square, a display title that ends in an orange period, a short description and actions.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A thin orange bar on a dark 2px to 6px track, modeled on the turtle fuel gauge.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder block to hold space while content loads.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Toast notifications from the sonner package, dressed in Lantern colors with a hard offset shadow and lucide status icons.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A spinning orange loader, plus a block spinner that pulses three squares like a terminal waiting on a reply.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Small file chips with an icon, name and size, plus idle, uploading, error and done states.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Chat bubbles in the Lantern style: sent messages in a raised panel with an orange edge, replies in the card panel.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Mono uppercase dividers and status notes for a thread, like day breaks, joins and system events.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Layout for one chat message: avatar, header, content and footer, aligned to the start or end of the thread.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A chat scroll area that starts at the newest message, follows new messages and shows a jump to latest button when you scroll up.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: A TurtleDeck-style app shell: a collapsible sidebar with nav groups and a user menu, a header with breadcrumb and search, a stats row, a mining chart, a live console and a data table of turtles.

items.name: docs-layout
items.title: Docs Layout
items.description: A documentation page shell: header with search, grouped sidebar nav, a Prose article and an On this page list. On phones the nav moves into a sheet.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: An FAQ section: a heading, intro and contact card on the left and a numbered accordion on the right. It stacks into one column on phones.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: A features section with a heading, intro and six cards, one of them a wide highlighted card with a small terminal.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: A site footer with the brand, three link columns, a newsletter field and a status line. Columns fold into two on phones.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The Lantern landing hero: announcement bar, navbar, a big two-line heading with calls to action, and a tilted terminal typing a session inside orbit rings. A stat strip sits below.

items.name: login
items.title: Login
items.description: A split-screen sign in page: the form on the left with a show/hide password, remember me and GitHub sign in, and a tilted terminal on a grid on the right. The right panel hides on phones.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not Found
items.description: A 404 page with a big Space Grotesk 404, a tilted terminal that fails to resolve hub://page-not-found/, and buttons back home and to search.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Three plan cards with a monthly and yearly toggle, the middle plan raised with an orange border and hard shadow, and an FAQ accordion underneath.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: A settings page with a section nav that turns into a select on phones: profile, hub site address and visibility, notification switches and a danger zone with a confirm dialog. Saving shows a toast.

items.name: signup
items.title: Signup
items.description: A create-account page with name, email and a password strength meter, a terms checkbox and inline validation errors, beside a short list of what the account includes.
